title: Authenticated relay RPC reports a pre-send local authority refusal as origin_read_failed
outcome: When local authority changes after the relay wrapper's lease check but before the authenticated RPC sends (for example, a durability hold begins, or a lease or incarnation check fails), the causal-completion pull records the typed relay authority reason, not origin_read_failed, while the existing ApiError is kept.
acceptance: Authenticated relay RPC reports a pre-send local authority refusal as origin_read_failed is done
